title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 4.2 Modeling with Linear Functions: Build linear models from verbal descriptions.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 4.2 Modeling with Linear Functions: Build linear models from verbal descriptions.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "4.2 Modeling with Linear Functions", prints these objectives: "Build linear models from verbal descriptions." "Model a set of data with a linear function.". The section text says: "Elan is a college student who plans to spend a summer in Seattle. Elan has saved $3,500 for their trip and anticipates spending $400 each week on rent, food, and activities. How can we write a linear model to represent this situation? What would be the x -intercept, and what can Elan learn from it? To answer these and related questions, we can create a model using a linear function. Models such as this one can be extremely useful for analyzing relationships and making predictions based on those…" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
